domain: Human resources management system for a mid-sized enterprise.

glossary.definition: A formal employee request for planned absence from work, submitted through the HR system.
Approval granted by the system without requiring manual review by a manager.

The period during which a leave request must be submitted relative to the requested start date; requests submitted fewer than 2 business days before the start date are routed to expedited manual review regardless of eligibility status.

business_rules.rule: Upon automatic approval or manual review routing, the system must send the employee a notification within 60 seconds stating the outcome and, in the case of manual review routing, the expected response time from the manager.
